source: owner paste: WNBA scoreboard + full player box scores, August 10 2026
model_status: ABSENT — no WNBA model exists in this system. Nothing below is a forecast grade, because there is no forecast to grade.

integrity_checks.method: Deterministic checks on the pasted player boxes. Nothing was imputed and no value was taken on trust.

team_minutes.rule: a 40-minute WNBA game with five on the floor is exactly 200 team-minutes
team_minutes.verdict: PASS — the 0.02-0.03 residual is second-level rounding in the per-player MM:SS values, and no game shows an overtime-sized excess

integrity_checks.player_sums_vs_totals_row: PASS for all four teams on FGM, FGA, 3PM, FTM and PTS
integrity_checks.points_identity: PASS — 2*(FGM-3PM) + 3*3PM + FTM equals stated PTS exactly for all four teams (95, 107, 88, 97)
integrity_checks.box_vs_scoreboard: PASS — summed player points equal the scoreboard final for all four teams
integrity_checks.significance: These catch transcription and arithmetic corruption. They cannot detect a source that is internally consistent and wrong; that is what the tier-1 requirement is for.

market_layer_outcome.basis: data/wnba/analysis/2026-08-10_market.json — same-book two-sided de-vig across the 4-book panel, valid here (unlike the MLB cross-book board)
market_layer_outcome.sides: the market's favourite won 1 of 2 — ATL held at -1000 across all four books delivered; CHI, a 55.4% road favourite, lost outright by 9
market_layer_outcome.spreads: ATL -15.5 did NOT cover, winning by 12. CHI -2.5 lost outright, so SEA +2.5 covered.
market_layer_outcome.totals: both went OVER — 202 against 187.5, and 185 against 179.5
market_layer_outcome.EVIDENCE_CLASS: n = 2. This establishes nothing about the market, and it cannot, because two games carry no information. It is recorded to keep the ledger contiguous, not to support a claim.

third_party_projection_recorded_not_adop.what_it_is: The pasted scoreboard carries EST Score and EST Line columns from an external projection system. It is NOT this system's output and is NOT adopted as one.
third_party_projection_recorded_not_adop.observed: external margin errors were +2.0 (ATL by 12 against a projected 10) and +5.8 (SEA by 9 against a projected 3.2). Notably the external projection favoured SEA by 3.2 while the market favoured CHI by 2.5 — they disagreed on the SIDE, and the external system was right.
third_party_projection_recorded_not_adop.handling_rule: This is the same class as the Massey overlay flagged on 2026-08-08. External ratings are quarantined: they may be recorded verbatim as observed third-party output, and they may never become a feature, a benchmark, or a substitute for a model this system does not have. 'massey' is already in the frozen forbidden_predictive_columns list for exactly this reason.
third_party_projection_recorded_not_adop.caution: One game in which an external system beat the market is not evidence about that system. Treating it as such is precisely the post-hoc, winner-filtered reasoning already retracted in this repository on 2026-08-10.

mirror_currency_finding.test: Attempted to cross-validate this owner box against the two sportsdataverse mirrors cloned earlier today.
mirror_currency_finding.result: NOT POSSIBLE. Both mirrors stop before this slate: ESPN team_box 2026 has a maximum game_date of 2026-08-01, and the official-family 2026 box files likewise carry no 2026-08-10 row.
mirror_currency_finding.measured_lag: approximately 9 days behind the live slate as of 2026-08-11
mirror_currency_finding.operational_consequence: The mirrors are usable for HISTORICAL walk-forward training, which is what they were acquired for. They are NOT usable for prospective grading — a forecast registered today cannot be graded from them for over a week. Prospective grading must come from a tier-1 owner capture or a direct official pull, and the ingestion design must not assume the mirror is current.
mirror_currency_finding.relation_to_the_transport_caveat: This also means the mirror-independence spot-check I still owe cannot be run against recent games; it must be run against a historical sample where both the mirror and wnba.com carry the same date.
